title: Block Out Level 21 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 21 is a triple-boss ladder. Break the framed `9` panel first, unwind the colorful middle strip second, and only then start shrinking the lower `16` and `18` panels.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 21 is a triple-boss ladder. Break the framed `9` panel first, unwind the colorful middle strip second, and only then start shrinking the lower `16` and `18` panels.
landmarks: Block Out Level 21 is a triple-boss ladder.
Break the framed `9` panel first, unwind the colorful middle strip second, and only then start shrinking the lower `16` and `18` panels.
The board mixes Blue, Yellow, Green and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The lower `16` and `18` values are phase two and phase three.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Work the top counters and clear the upper color band so the framed `9` panel is exposed.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Drop the `9` panel before touching the lower bosses.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Use the freed middle corridor to rotate the pink, green, and blue bars.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the lower `16` panel once the center is no longer packed.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the `18` panel begin falling only after the `16` frame has already opened.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Save the floor green exit for the late cleanup when the lower panels are thin.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the remaining tall color bars after both bottom bosses have collapsed.

failurePoints: Trying to shrink the lower framed values while the top `9` is still alive.
Leaving the middle strip packed after the top boss has opened.
